summary: The dashboard's security plugin renders a single-page form at /app/login. Its button calls a script handler that posts the two values in the background; the form has no action.

sources.title: Wazuh security dashboards plugin 4.14.8 login page
Wazuh security dashboards plugin 4.14.8 constants: the login page is the application /app/login
Wazuh dashboard 4.14.8 package manifest: the EUI import is OpenSearch UI 1.19.0
OpenSearch UI 1.19.0 text field: remaining props are spread on a native input of type text
OpenSearch UI 1.19.0 password field: a native input whose type starts as password in dual mode
OpenSearch UI 1.19.0 button: a native button without href, an anchor with one
OpenSearch UI 1.19.0 form: renders the element named by its component prop

selectors.locator: lines 195-203 (field), 299 (form); source oui-text lines 103-113 put both attributes on a native input; source oui-form lines 113-116 render the form element
selectors.note: The attribute values are written in the plugin. That they end up on an input element was read in the component library the dashboard pins, not seen in rendered markup.

selectors.locator: lines 208-216; source oui-password lines 105-107 start the type as password, lines 181-191 put the attributes on a native input
selectors.note: The type changes to text only when the user clicks the show button.

selectors.locator: lines 222-232; source oui-button lines 283 and 304-306: a native button with the given type when there is no href
selectors.note: The single sign-on buttons carry the same data-test-subj but have an href, so the library renders them as anchors.

staysInteractive.note: OpenID Connect and SAML are separate link buttons. A dashboard configured for those only shows no username and password fields, and the login then stops as a layout mismatch.

schemaGaps: A dashboard with a configured base path has the page at that prefix followed by app/login. The format has no path-suffix or installation-relative gate, so only a dashboard at the host root is covered. Under a base path nothing is filled.
notes: The same data-test-subj and aria-label values, the password type and the form element are in the plugin at 4.9.0, 4.9.2, 4.12.0 and 5.0.0-rc1 (read at those tags on 2026-10-12). Wazuh's own fork of the plugin starts at 4.9.0; dashboards older than that ship another build that was not read. Class names are not used: the library's class prefix was not verified. The component library is pinned to an exact version (source dashboard-package). The inputs are React-controlled: they need real input events, not a value assignment.
